onlineBcp stream detector

Source: R/dfr_onlinebcp.R
dfr_onlinebcp.Rd

Monitors a univariate stream with the online Bayesian change point detection of online_bcp(): every observation updates the posterior of the location of the last change point, and a drift is reported when the largest posterior exceeds threshold at a new location. Since it monitors the distribution of a feature, it is used for virtual concept drift.

Usage

dfr_onlinebcp(
  target_feat = NULL,
  theta = 0.9,
  alpha = 1,
  beta = 1,
  threshold = 0.5,
  numerics = c("stable", "reference"),
  max_run = NULL
)

Arguments

target_feat

Feature to be monitored.

theta

Probability that no change occurs at a step.

alpha, beta

Hyperparameters of the inverse-gamma prior of the variance.

threshold

Threshold of the posterior probability (th_cp).

numerics

"stable" (default) computes the weights in log scale with lgamma(). "reference" computes them as onlineBcp 0.1.4 does, with gamma() and powers that overflow for segments longer than about 340 observations; the overflowing weights are set to 0, which forces change points at multiples of about 341 observations (see Details).

max_run

If set, the posterior is kept for at most the last max_run candidate locations (the oldest are dropped), which bounds the cost of a step on long streams without changes. NULL (default) keeps them all, as the reference.

Value

dfr_onlinebcp object. After fit(), drifter_output holds the largest posterior probability (max_prob) and the location found (location, 0 when below the threshold) for every observation.

Details

The detector reports a drift on the observation at which a new change point location is found; that location (the last observation before the change) is kept in obj$changepoints with its posterior probability. The data are assumed approximately normal within segments; transform them first otherwise (for counts, sqrt(y + 3/8), as in the paper). Missing values are skipped.

References

Yigiter, A., Chen, J., An, L. and Danacioglu, N. (2015). An on-line CNV detection method for short sequencing reads. Journal of Applied Statistics, 42(7), 1556-1571. doi:10.1080/02664763.2014.1001330

Xu, H., Yigiter, A. and Chen, J. (2022). onlineBcp: An R package for online change point detection using a Bayesian approach. SoftwareX, 17, 100999. doi:10.1016/j.softx.2022.100999

Examples

library(daltoolbox)
library(heimdall)
set.seed(1)
data <- data.frame(serie = c(stats::rnorm(100, 0), stats::rnorm(100, 3)))
model <- fit(dfr_onlinebcp(theta = 0.95, threshold = 0.7), data)
model$changepoints
#>   location post.prob detected_at
#> 1      100 0.7204097         105
